description: Verified additional publisher recipe specifications for otherwise unchanged Shakerrr cards. The existing recipes and MJ Personal Versions are retained.

padang-swizzle.label: PUNCH
padang-swizzle.creator: Zac Overman
padang-swizzle.instructions: Combine in a Pilsner or Collins glass. Add crushed ice and swizzle until cold. Top with crushed ice and garnish with a cinnamon stick through a lime wheel. The publisher suggests a briefly smoking cinnamon garnish; extinguish it before drinking.
padang-swizzle.history: Zac Overman's swizzle layers sherry, aged rum and a little Islay Scotch with citrus and cinnamon, served over crushed ice.

bicicletta.label: Liquor.com

ingredients.name: Dry white wine (Pinot Grigio or Sauvignon Blanc)

bicicletta.instructions: Add dry white wine and Campari to a rocks or wine glass. Fill three-quarters with ice. Top with chilled club soda and stir briefly.

bicicletta.label: Difford’s Guide · Bicicletta Spritz
bicicletta.instructions: Combine ingredients with ice in a highball glass and stir gently.

bicicletta.label: PUNCH
bicicletta.instructions: Combine Campari and white wine in a wine glass, add ice, top with soda, and stir gently.
bicicletta.history: The name means 'bicycle' in Italian. Folklore connects it to older café customers cycling home unsteadily after their afternoon aperitivo.

american-trilogy.label: Difford’s Guide
american-trilogy.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, then strain into a chilled rocks glass over a large piece of ice. Express an orange twist over the glass.
american-trilogy.history: Created by Richard Boccato and Michael McIlroy at Little Branch in New York, the American Trilogy replaces a standard Old-Fashioned's single spirit with rye and bonded applejack.

american-trilogy.label: PUNCH
american-trilogy.creator: Richard Boccato and Michael McIlroy
american-trilogy.instructions: Saturate the brown sugar cube with orange bitters in a rocks glass and muddle to a paste. Add rye and bonded applejack, stir with ice, and garnish with a long orange peel.
american-trilogy.history: Created by Richard Boccato and Michael McIlroy at Little Branch in New York, the American Trilogy replaces a standard Old-Fashioned's single spirit with rye and bonded applejack.

capitan.label: PUNCH · Bar Capitán Meléndez
capitan.creator: Roberto Meléndez
capitan.instructions: Stir pisco and sweet vermouth briefly with ice in a mixing glass, then strain into a chilled coupe.
capitan.history: A Peruvian pisco-and-vermouth classic associated with Lima's Belle Époque drinking culture. This version uses equal parts and an olive.

capitan.label: Difford’s Guide · El Capitán
capitan.instructions: Stir with ice, then fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
capitan.history: The pisco-vermouth combination may trace to Italian immigration to Peru in the nineteenth century; the name is often linked to army captains in Puno in the 1920s, although its exact origin is uncertain.

blazing-saddles.label: The Jolly Bartender · adaptation
blazing-saddles.creator: Nate Wilkinson, adapting Brad Farran's Death & Co. recipe

ingredients.name: Catoctin Creek Colossal X malt whiskey (substituted for High West oat whiskey)
Homemade grapefruit liqueur (substituted for Combier Pamplemousse Rose)
Cinnamon syrup (simple/demerara with a little cinnamon whiskey)
Angostura bitters (substituted for Elemakule Tiki bitters)

blazing-saddles.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe.
blazing-saddles.history: A cinnamon-and-grapefruit whiskey sour originally created by Brad Farran for Death & Co. This blog version openly substitutes several ingredients; the original book recipe remains a separate tab.
